messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Please keep only one intensity of listed features among multiple runs from one sample.
parts:
Dear Chris,

This type of issue can be happened in most of spectral processing tools except Skyline. From MSstats v3.7.3, it can be solved if you use the converter functions in MSstats for output from Skyline, Spectronaut, Progenesis, MaxQuant, Proteome Discoverer. (Please check MSstats manual from msstats.org) If you used other tool, please make sure that MSstats needs one row with one intensity value for one feature (PSM for DDA, transition level for SRM, fragmentation for DIA) and one MS run. This error message means there are more than one rows for one feature and one MS run.

If you have issue with converter functions, please share your data with us.

Hope to help.

Sincerely,
- Meena

My guess is that you may have fractionation. If yes, I'm not sure whether SWATH2stats works for fractionation case and I haven't had the chance to check the fractionation cases for SWATH2stats. Because MSstats needs more columns, 'Fraction' and 'techReplicate' in MSstats input for fractionation case.

If not fractionation, my guess that there is incorrect annotation for Run.
